taskNotes: Turoths can be assigned by Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar, and Nieve upon reaching 55 Slayer and 60 combat.
Turoths are found only in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
Turoths have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition (arrows and bolts), or the Magic Dart spell.
Turoths attack with somewhat inaccurate stab attacks that can hit up to 9; Protect from Melee will negate all of their damage.
Players should bring an Herb sack because Turoths frequently drop herbs.
Safespots are available throughout the dungeon, and prayer flicking is viable for food conservation.
Spiked Turoth is the superior version unlocked with Bigger and Badder; it has no special mechanics but is significantly more accurate and has a max hit of 29.
The slayerTargetId 241 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract, 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
recommendedMethod: Use leaf-bladed battleaxe melee, broad ammunition ranged, or Magic Dart only. Protect from Melee negates all damage; safespotting with broad ammunition or Magic Dart is a low-supply alternative.
